channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: US Lifts Sanctions on Myanmar Businessman's Daughter
item.description: The United States has lifted sanctions imposed on the daughter of a businessman linked to the Myanmar military. The sanctions were originally put in place due to her father's alleged financial support for the military junta. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
